name: Oil Spill Segmentation Dataset (800x600)
description: SAR-based oil spill and seepage segmentation dataset from Sentinel-1 (C-band), Cantarell field, Gulf of Mexico, acquired January–September 2020. 173 image/mask triplets at 800x600 pixels (IMG-RGB, LABELS-1D single-channel, LABELS-RGB visualization), paired 8-bit and 16-bit GeoTIFF raster tiles, and per-polygon tabular radiometric/geometric feature tables (385 labeled oil polygons, 67 columns, in both bit depths). Includes train/val/test split manifests (grouped by source scene) and two reproducible baseline pipelines with registered benchmark results: a classical unsupervised method (Felzenszwalb segmentation, selected as the best of 7 candidates tested) and a supervised deep-learning baseline (TinyUNet), evaluated with identical pixel-level metrics (IoU, pixel accuracy) for direct comparison. Repository and code: https://github.com/Garcia-INPE/oilspill-detection-dataset
